artworks.title: Diomedes and Aphrodite
artworks.description: Miller's wound on the goddess — the aristeia that made Diomedes Athena's favourite before Argos barred him at the gate.

artworks.title: Diomedes and Glaucus
artworks.description: Rubens' exchange of armour — guest-right between the lines, the bronze-for-gold swap the poets name after the Argive king.

artworks.title: The Return of Odysseus
artworks.description: Picart's Returns — the bitter homecomings that awaited the victors while Diomedes fled Argos by night.
